mainEntity.name: Which is cheaper, Hostinger or Namecheap?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hostinger Premium is $1.99 a month on a 48-month term and renews at $10.99. Namecheap Stellar is $2.28 a month and renews at $5.88.

mainEntity.name: Are the entry plans the same size?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Both list 3 sites and 20 GB of SSD storage.
All About Cookies measured 100% uptime for Hostinger. Cybernews measured 99.29% for Namecheap. The tests used different methods and dates.

mainEntity.name: Does Namecheap have a Black Friday sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: We found none on its pages. Its Black Friday page referred to 2025.
